query:
SELECT
            derived_output_key AS "derived_output_key!",
            content AS "content!: JsonValue"
         FROM account_research_chunks
         WHERE organization_id = $1
           AND account_id = $2
           AND data_type = 'DERIVED_OUTPUT'::account_research_chunk_data_type
           AND superseded_by IS NULL
           AND derived_output_key = ANY($3::text[])
         ORDER BY generated_at DESC NULLS LAST, updated_at DESC, id DESC
